title: When the Glasshouse Burns
author: Elodie Brightwater
blurb: Jonah Blackwood, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
